scope: Read-only scientific review of the final lead ruling; no simulation, fitting, model call, benchmark/reference/control execution or Git mutation.
checked: Conditional response-mean theta_H is distinguished from the finite R-draw sample contrast.
Mean interpretation requires consistency/state restoration, no interference and receiver-sampling assumptions; deterministic seed derivation does not prove independent random draws.
Full-branch slot inclusion is not a binary treatment propensity and does not require inverse-propensity weighting.
Primary reporting is descriptive; neither normal nor Hoeffding confidence intervals, efficacy or futility claims are released.
Hoeffding is not assumption-free; a fixed-roster prefix-law target can be defined without random task sampling, while wider task generalization needs additional justification.
No score-driven stopping is distinct from score-independent missingness; binary completion bounds require no missing-at-random assumption.
Failed initial generation leaves twelve continuation slots missing without fabricated answers, substitution, retry or root deletion.
Prospective task/domain/reference/private-suite adaptation is explicitly a new measurement version and does not rescore prior evidence.
Source/mock allowance is one existing CPU worker for 30 elapsed minutes with zero real model or benchmark/reference/control execution and no automatic renewal.
